'''Fabien Jacques''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 71 FL from Liege, Bel. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| Decipher era || [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 71 FL (Liege, Bel)<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
